function parallelWriteZarr(fileName, data, varargin)
% Mex exit probe only (CI job exit-probe; this file is never on the path
% otherwise): the probe step copies it into a mex variant folder as
% parallelWriteZarr.m, and cpp-zarr's mex as parallelWriteZarr_orig. It casts
% the data to the class of the zarr array that is already there, so that the mex
% runs no OpenMP of its own (its dtype conversion is its only parallel region of
% its own), and notes each call in the file that PROBE_CAST_LOG names.
cls = probe_zarr_class(fileName);
casted = ~isempty(cls) && ~isa(data, cls) && isreal(data);
logFn = getenv('PROBE_CAST_LOG');
if ~isempty(logFn)
    fid = fopen(logFn, 'a');
    if fid > 0
        fprintf(fid, '%s data %s, array %s%s\n', char(datetime('now', 'Format', 'HH:mm:ss.SS')), ...
            class(data), cls, repmat(', cast', 1, double(casted)));
        fclose(fid);
    end
end
if casted
    if strcmp(cls, 'logical')
        data = logical(data);
    else
        data = cast(data, cls);
    end
end
parallelWriteZarr_orig(fileName, data, varargin{:});
end

function cls = probe_zarr_class(fileName)
% the class of the zarr array's data type ('' if there is no array yet)
cls = '';
v2 = struct('u1', 'uint8', 'u2', 'uint16', 'u4', 'uint32', 'u8', 'uint64', 'i1', 'int8', ...
    'i2', 'int16', 'i4', 'int32', 'i8', 'int64', 'f4', 'single', 'f8', 'double', 'b1', 'logical');
v3 = struct('uint8', 'uint8', 'uint16', 'uint16', 'uint32', 'uint32', 'uint64', 'uint64', ...
    'int8', 'int8', 'int16', 'int16', 'int32', 'int32', 'int64', 'int64', 'float32', 'single', ...
    'float64', 'double', 'bool', 'logical');
try
    if isfile(fullfile(fileName, '.zarray'))
        m = jsondecode(fileread(fullfile(fileName, '.zarray')));
        t = m.dtype(end - 1 : end);
        if isfield(v2, t)
            cls = v2.(t);
        end
    elseif isfile(fullfile(fileName, 'zarr.json'))
        m = jsondecode(fileread(fullfile(fileName, 'zarr.json')));
        if isfield(v3, m.data_type)
            cls = v3.(m.data_type);
        end
    end
catch
    cls = '';
end
end
